newsitem.title: USA: Pace Health Management backlog rises.
newsitem.headline: Pace Health Management backlog rises.

text.p: Pace Health Management Systems said Friday its order backlog was more than $5 million at the end of the first quarter, up from $1.9 million at December 31, 1996.

"With a strong backlog and excellent funnel, we are optimistic about Pace's revenue growth in future quarters," Roger Huseman, chief financial officer, said in a statement. Pace said it had record contract signings during the quarter.
Earlier Friday, the medical software company reported a net loss of $1.2 million, or $0.23 a share, for the quarter, compared to $630,120, or $0.15 a share, a year ago.
Pace shares were unchanged at 3-1/4 Friday.
